name_reason: Name follows the fd2_<verb>_<descriptor> game-function convention, accurately reflects the logic (reads a battle-map tile's metadata + per-sprite attribute record at a given grid position into a caller buffer), and carries no Ghidra address residue. 'tile_attribute' matches the global it reads (data_fd2_tile_attribute_flags_buffer_ptr) and the *_at_pos suffix matches the (world_x, world_y) lookup. Consistent with battle.c siblings (fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos is itself cited as the form exemplar in the fd2_recompute_runtime_char_total_stats shard).
purpose: Read battle-map tile metadata (sprite index + terrain class) and the tile's 4-byte per-sprite attribute-flag record at grid position (world_x, world_y), unpacking all of it into an 8-byte caller-supplied output buffer. The wide-xref accessor every battle subsystem uses to query a tile's properties (terrain AP/DP modifier, movement cost, event-tile detection, cursor-overlay attribute check).
logic_summary: __CHK(0xC) frame check at entry. Computes tile_meta_addr = data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr + (world_y*data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles + world_x)*4 (4-byte tile meta cells, row-major). Reads sprite_idx = *(u16)(tile_meta_addr+4) & 0x3FF (10-bit tile-sheet index) and terrain_byte = *(u8)(tile_meta_addr+6). Writes out_buf[+0 u16]=sprite_idx, out_buf[+2 u16]=terrain_byte&0x1F (5-bit terrain class). Then attr_ptr = data_fd2_tile_attribute_flags_buffer_ptr + (int16)sprite_idx*4 and copies the 4 attribute bytes to out_buf[+4..+7]. Single basic block, no early returns, cyclomatic complexity 1.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos(uint32 world_x, uint32 world_y, uint32 out_buf)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: world_x -- tile column (grid X) of the cell to query. Used as the low term of the row-major index (world_y*width + world_x)*4 into the tile-meta map. Callers pass a character's grid X from the runtime char array (e.g. pAttacker[0]) or an explicit map column. In Ghidra still the generic placeholder param_1; src already names it world_x.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: out_buf -- address of the caller-supplied 8-byte output buffer the unpacked tile data is written to (+0 u16 sprite_idx, +2 u16 terrain_class, +4..+7 the 4-byte attribute record). Callers pass a local stack buffer (e.g. tile_attr_buf) and then read fields back; e.g. combat code reads byte +5 (attr record byte +1) as a terrain-effect class id indexing the AP/DP terrain-modifier tables. In Ghidra still the generic placeholder param_3; src already names it out_buf.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: writes 8 bytes into the caller buffer at out_buf -- +0 u16 sprite_idx (10-bit), +2 u16 terrain_class (5-bit), +4..+7 the 4-byte per-sprite attribute-flag record.
